name: HGX B200
notes: Official NVIDIA Blackwell datasheet's 'Technical Specifications' table only gives Total FP4 and Total FP8/FP6 Tensor Core totals for HGX B200 -- no total TF32, FP16/BF16, FP64, or INT8 figures are vendor-published at the node level, left null rather than derived from per-GPU x 8. total_fp32_tflops (600) is derived here (75 TFLOPS/GPU x 8, per-GPU figure is vendor-sourced) since a separate NVIDIA HGX B200 PCF Summary document independently corroborates this exact total (labeled, with an apparent unit typo, as '600 PFLOPS' -- see b200-sxm-hgx.json notes). Per datasheet footnote 1, FP4/FP8/FP6 totals are sparse-spec (dense not independently published for totals). FP8 and FP6 totals published as one combined figure. power_kw_max estimated as 8 GPUs x 1000W = 8.0kW (not independently vendor-published for the node alone). networking left null -- this datasheet does not name a specific NIC model for HGX B200 (unlike the Blackwell Ultra HGX B300 sheet's explicit ConnectX-8 mention); needs a follow-up source (e.g. DGX B200 datasheet) before populating. cooling_type set to 'air' per this datasheet's HGX B200 real-time inference comparisons, which are explicitly 'air-cooled'; liquid-cooled HGX B200 deployments also exist per third-party sources.

_sources.total_fp32_tflops: Derived: 75 TFLOPS/GPU (p.7 Technical Specifications table) x 8 GPUs. Independently corroborated by NVIDIA HGX B200 PCF Summary (images.nvidia.com/aem-dam/Solutions/documents/HGX-B200-PCF-Summary.pdf), which lists 'FP32 600 PFLOPS' -- treated as a unit-label typo (TFLOPS, not PFLOPS) in that document rather than a conflicting data point.
